the crest survives ONLY here, painted in TWO paints on weathered cream canvas: a hanging lantern with fine glazing bars inside a laurel ring under an arched wordmark. Paint has bled into the canvas weave so the glazing bars and the gaps between laurel leaves carry far less separation than they appear at full frame (counters close at page-print size); the laurel ring encloses an interior that background-removal cannot punch and returns as a solid opaque disc; and the arched wordmark reads dominant, so a prompt naming the whole crest returns the wordmark and silently drops the lantern and ring, while a prompt naming the banner returns the canvas
